description: This file defines the data structures, macros, and function prototypes for a C dynamic strings library (SDSLib 2.0), used for managing dynamic string buffers in C programs. It includes structure definitions for different SDS types, inline functions for string length and capacity management, and function declarations for string operations.

methods.name: sdslen
methods.description: Inline function to get the length of the SDS string based on its type.

methods.name: sdsavail
methods.description: Inline function to get the available space in the SDS string buffer.

methods.name: sdssetlen
methods.description: Inline function to set the length of the SDS string.

methods.name: sdsinclen
methods.description: Inline function to increment the length of the SDS string.

methods.name: sdsalloc
methods.description: Inline function to get the total allocated size of the SDS string buffer.

methods.name: sdssetalloc
methods.description: Inline function to set the allocated size of the SDS string buffer.
